caption: The drawing is made with fine black or dark gray lines on a beige or light tan paper background and contains multiple technical sketches of a rectangular table or furniture piece and its components, shown from varying angles and perspectives. In the upper left corner, there are two adjacent top-down views of square surfaces, each containing circular inlays, labeled with dimensions; next to them, there is an overhead drawing of a curved segment labeled "Curve," alongside a labeled "Section" view. Adjacent to these, in the top right, is a detailed front and side view of a vertically-oriented, cylindrical furniture leg with grooves and ridges, showing measurements for width and height along with a small cross-section view labeled with dimensions and the word "reedings." Centrally located, toward the upper middle, are diagrams with a series of circles and narrow rectangles, also annotated with measurements. The lower half of the drawing includes a side profile of a rectangular table with a curved apron, and two elevation views of the same table from the front and side, all annotated with detailed dimensions. The composition is structured, with all views aligned horizontally and vertically, and precise annotations and measurements provided throughout. There are some faint smudges, stains, and light wear marks on the paper.
title: Table
